punchline: Right now your heart is beating and you are not thinking about it, and Murphy says repeated thoughts end up in the same quiet place.
thirty_sec: Joseph Murphy starts with the body: the heart, the breath and digestion all run without orders. He says the subconscious does that work and also accepts whatever is pressed into it, like soil taking seed. So thoughts you repeat with conviction end up shaping your habits. It is his belief, offered with Bible quotations, and the book runs no experiments.
